venue: American Economic Review: Papers and Proceedings
abstract: In low-rate environments, policy strategies that involve holding rates “lower for longer” (L4L) may mitigate the effects of the effective lower bound (ELB). However, these strategies work in part by managing the public's expectations, which is not always realistic. Using the Fed's large-scale macroeconometric model, we study the effectiveness of L4L policies when financial market participants are forward-looking but other agents are not. We find that the resulting limited ability to manage expectations reduces but does not eliminate the advantages of L4L policies. The best policies provide adequate stimulus at the ELB while avoiding sizable overshoots of inflation and output.
abstract_zh: 在低利率环境下，将利率维持在“更长时间保持低位”（L4L）的政策策略，可能会减轻有效下限（ELB）的影响。然而，这些策略在一定程度上是通过管理公众预期发挥作用的，而这并不总是现实的。利用美联储的大型宏观计量模型，我们研究了当金融市场参与者具有前瞻性而其他主体不具有前瞻性时，L4L政策的有效性。我们发现，由此产生的管理预期能力的局限性会降低但不会消除L4L政策的优势。最佳政策能够在有效下限附近提供充分的刺激，同时避免通胀和产出的大幅超调。

title: Quantitative Easing and the 'New Normal' in Monetary Policy
Some Implications of Uncertainty and Misperception for Monetary Policy
Mapping Heat in the U.S. Financial System
abstract: We provide a framework for assessing the build-up of vulnerabilities in the U.S. financial system. We collect forty-four indicators of financial and balance-sheet conditions, cutting across measures of valuation pressures, nonfinancial borrowing, and financial-sector health. We place the data in economic categories, track their evolution, and develop an algorithmic approach to monitoring vulnerabilities that can complement the more judgmental approach of most official-sector organizations. Our approach picks up rising imbalances in the U.S. financial system through the mid-2000s, presaging the financial crisis. We also highlight several statistical properties of our approach: most importantly, our summary measures of system-wide vulnerabilities lead the credit-to-GDP gap (a key gauge in Basel III and related research) by a year or more. Thus, our framework may provide useful information for setting macroprudential policy tools such as the countercyclical capital buffer.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了一个评估美国金融体系脆弱性积累的框架。我们收集了四十四项金融和资产负债表状况的指标，涵盖估值压力、非金融部门借贷以及金融部门健康状况等方面的衡量指标。我们将这些数据归入经济类别，追踪其演变，并开发了一种监测脆弱性的算法方法，该方法可以补充大多数官方机构较为主观的判断方式。我们的方法捕捉到了2000年代中期之前美国金融体系中不断累积的失衡，预示了金融危机。我们还突出了该方法的若干统计特性：最重要的是，我们对整体系统脆弱性的综合指标，比信贷与GDP缺口（巴塞尔协议III及相关研究中的关键指标）领先一年或更长时间。因此，我们的框架可能为设定逆周期资本缓冲等宏观审慎政策工具提供有用信息。

title: Estimating the Common Trend Rate of Inflation for Consumer Prices and Consumer Prices Excluding Food and Energy Prices
abstract: I examine the common trend in inflation for consumer prices and consumer prices excluding prices of food and energy. Both the personal consumption expenditure (PCE) indexes and the consumer price indexes (CPI) are examined. The statistical model employed is a bivariate integrated moving average process; this model extends a univariate model that fits the data on inflation very well. The bivariate model forecasts as well as the univariate models. The results suggest that the relationship between overall consumer prices, consumer prices excluding the prices of food and energy, and the common trend has changed significantly over time. In the 1970s and early 1980s, movements in overall prices and prices excluding food and energy prices both contained information about the trend; in recent data, the trend is best gauged by focusing solely on prices excluding food and energy prices.
abstract_zh: 我考察了消费者价格以及剔除食品和能源价格后的消费者价格的通胀共同趋势。两种指数，即个人消费支出（PCE）指数和消费者价格指数（CPI），均纳入了考察。所采用的统计模型是双变量积分移动平均过程；该模型扩展了一个对通胀数据拟合非常好的单变量模型。双变量模型的预测效果与单变量模型相当。结果表明，总体消费者价格、剔除食品和能源价格后的消费者价格与共同趋势之间的关系随时间发生了显著变化。在1970年代和1980年代初，总体价格和剔除食品与能源价格后的价格变动都包含关于趋势的信息；而在近期数据中，最好仅通过剔除食品和能源价格后的价格来判断趋势。
